title: Can I BEAT Hyper Chess?
summary: Hyper Chess (Steam): real-time chess with no turns, like Kung Fu Chess. Pieces move simultaneously (animated travel), each move draws from a shared MOVES meter that replenishes; moving pieces can be intercepted mid-path (except knights). King capture wins; castling seemed unavailable. He wins 3 of 5 online games (vs players like 'Clob') and earns in-game cash ($75/$100/$20 per win).
rules: Standard setup, 3D board; no turns: both players move whenever they like.
A MOVES meter (blue bar) limits how many moves you can have in flight; it replenishes after moves complete.
A piece in motion can't be re-moved until it arrives; pieces travel over time and can be intercepted/captured mid-path by enemy pieces (knights jump and can't be intercepted).
Castling appeared unavailable in the online game (he could not castle).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 3 wins (3 of 5).

board.theme_notes: Hyper Chess 3D board (white/blue in frames), oak or marble piece sets, side MOVES meter, menu Play Online/Local/Shop; win screen 'White wins' with flag and +$ reward

current_impl_issues: Legacy 'setuppos hyper' (knightriders/archbishops) is invented - Hyper Chess is real-time chess with a move-energy meter and interceptable moves.
